Agent Name: Orchestrator (thought)
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: It redirected the effort to verify Valley Loop, Four Mile, Mist, and Panorama—targets misaligned with the “waterfall hike” and “fully wheelchair accessible” criteria—misusing upstream search results and deviating from the correct candidates (Yosemite Falls, Bridalveil Fall). Although the loop began earlier, this decision deepened the loop (Rule 1) and introduced a key data misuse (Rule 2); from here, subsequent actions focused on non-qualifying trails, making recovery to the correct path unlikely (Rule 3).
